statement: Destructive failed-create cleanup and release classification require an operation-bound cleanup_token (failed-create:<operationId>); live pre-runtime retry and ordinary terminal settlement remain independent of claim availability, while terminal unclaimed FAILED target rows normalize through ReplicaStateMachine.claimFailedCreateCleanup before cleanup.

constraints.statement: hasValidFailedCreateCleanupPrecondition, matchesFailedCreatePreconditionTokens, matchesDelayedFailedCreateTargetPrecondition and isTerminalFailedCreateCleanupRemove require isFailedCreateCleanupToken (never null). admitCreateTerminalFailure never records a cleanup_token: null precondition in stepMetadata and never blocks failOperation on claim availability.

Preserve isUnclaimedPreRuntimeFailedCreateRow for in-flight pre-runtime CREATE retry. Normalize terminal unclaimed FAILED target rows through ReplicaStateMachine.claimFailedCreateCleanup under replicaCreateAdmissionOwner.runExclusive after verifying durable terminal FAILED operation identity and create_attempt_token, and preserve the 2-call-site deliverReplicaOperationRequest census.
